name: Crew Cab Short Bed (5'8") 4x2 LT

name: Crew Cab Standard Bed (6'9") 4x4 LT
src: chevrolet.com 2026 Silverado 2500 HD configurator Compare Dimensions; curb weight and tire from Chrome Data (4WD Crew Cab 159" LT). Width is Chevrolet's max at rear fenders, excluding mirrors.

name: Crew Cab Standard Bed ZR2 4x4
src: Chrome Data 2026 Silverado 2500HD 4WD Crew Cab 159" ZR2; box dimensions from chevrolet.com. Curb weight is the same base figure listed for the LT and likely understates the trim.

name: Crew Cab ZR2 4x4
src: chevrolet.com 2026 Colorado configurator Compare Dimensions, ZR2; curb weight from Chrome Data. Rear overhang measured without the bumper.

src: GM Upfitter Integration Silverado EV Specification Guide (body width without mirrors 83.8; tailgate/bed height 34.5). GM publishes curb weight as TBD, so it is omitted. Chevrolet's 2026 configurator lists a conflicting 85.3 in width; GM's explicitly labelled 83.8 is used. Rear overhang measured without the bumper.

name: Crew Cab Short Bed 4x2 Pro
src: GM dimension feed via Edmunds 2026 Sierra 1500 Pro Crew Cab 5.8ft; box length from GMC Build & Price. Width excludes mirrors.

name: Crew Cab Standard Bed 4x4 Pro
src: Edmunds and KBB 2026 Sierra 1500 Crew Cab 6.6ft (agree on height, clearance, curb weight); GM feed for wheelbase and box length. GMC's brochure quotes a 241.5-242.5 in length range.

name: Double Cab Standard Bed 4x2 Pro
src: GM dimension feed via Edmunds 2026 Sierra 1500 Pro Double Cab standard bed. Width excludes mirrors.

name: AT4X Crew Cab Short Bed 4x4
src: Edmunds and KBB 2026 Sierra 1500 AT4X Crew Cab; 78.7 in is the top of GMC's published 75.4-78.7 in lineup height range.

name: Crew Cab Standard Bed 4x4 SLT
src: Chrome Data 2026 Sierra 2500HD 4WD Crew Cab 159" SLT; box length from gmc.com. Width excludes mirrors (GMC separately publishes 105 in with mirrors).

name: AT4X Crew Cab Standard Bed 4x4
src: Chrome Data 2026 Sierra 2500HD 4WD Crew Cab 159" AT4X; tire is GMC's published 35-inch Goodyear Wrangler Territory MT. Curb weight omitted: the only published figure repeats the SLT's 6,825 lb, which cannot be right for a lifted 35-inch-tire trim.

name: Crew Cab AT4 4WD
src: Chrome Data 2026 Canyon 4WD Crew Cab AT4; clearance matches gmc.com. Width caveat: 72.4 in is GMC's published mirrors-folded figure rather than a true mirror-delete body width (84.4 in with mirrors extended). Rear overhang measured without the bumper. gmc.com lists wheelbase as 131.4 vs Chrome Data's 131.0.

name: AT4X Crew Cab 4WD
src: Chrome Data 2026 Canyon 4WD Crew Cab AT4X; clearance matches gmc.com. Same mirrors-folded width caveat as the AT4. Curb weight is the same figure Chrome Data assigns to the AT4.

name: 3X e4WD Crew Cab
src: Chrome Data 2026 HUMMER EV Pickup e4WD Crew Cab 3X; width excludes mirrors. Clearance is the standard ride height; the air suspension raises it to 15.9 in in Extract Mode. Curb weight omitted: not published for 2026 (the widely quoted 9,063 lb is a 2022 Edition 1 certification figure).

name: CrewMax 5.5' Bed 4x4 SR5
src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tundra Product Information. Width is Toyota's overall width excluding mirrors. Toyota publishes both a ground clearance (9.3) and a running ground clearance (11.2); the former is used. Weight is the low end of Toyota's published 5,390-5,490 lb band.

name: CrewMax 6.5' Bed 4x4 SR5
src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tundra Product Information. Weight is the low end of the published 5,620-5,720 lb band.

name: Double Cab 6.5' Bed 4x4 SR5
src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tundra Product Information. Weight is the low end of the published 5,380-5,490 lb band.

name: TRD Pro CrewMax 5.5' Bed 4x4
src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tundra Product Information (TRD Pro width and clearance explicitly called out; the height row shows no TRD Pro exception). Curb weight from Edmunds; Toyota publishes only a 6,010-6,095 lb band.

name: Double Cab 5' Bed 4x4 SR5
src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tacoma Product Information plus Edmunds SR5 Double Cab 4WD 5.0ft. Width excludes mirrors (77.9 in on 18-inch trims).

src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tacoma Product Information plus Edmunds SR5 Double Cab 4WD 6.1ft. Bed inner height is low confidence: Toyota's own 4x4 table says 21.2 while the 4x2 and XtraCab tables say 20.2 for the same box.

name: XtraCab 6' Bed 4x4 SR
src: Toyota USA Newsroom 2026 Tacoma Product Information (74.0 in on 17-inch steel wheels) plus Edmunds SR XtraCab 4WD 6.1ft.

name: Crew Cab SV 4x2 Long Bed (6' Bed)
src: Nissan 2026 Frontier press kit, long-wheelbase column. Ground clearance omitted: Nissan publishes only differential clearances for long-bed models and no database lists a running clearance for this configuration.

name: King Cab S 4x2 (6' Bed)
src: Nissan 2026 Frontier press kit King Cab dimension table; Chrome Data for ground clearance. Width excludes mirrors.

name: Crew Cab PRO-4X 4x4 (5' Bed)
src: Nissan 2026 Frontier press kit (PRO-4X short wheelbase; width measured over the fender flares); Chrome Data for ground clearance.

name: TrailSport AWD

name: Willys 4x4
src: jeep.com 2026 Gladiator Willys specs; Chrome Data for clearance, overhangs, load-floor height and tire.

src: jeep.com 2026 Gladiator Rubicon specs; Chrome Data for clearance, overhangs, load-floor height and tire.

src: jeep.com 2026 Gladiator Mojave specs; clearance matches the Stellantis 2026 Gladiator press kit. Load-floor height is not published for the Mojave.

name: SEL FWD
src: hyundaiusa.com 2026 Santa Cruz compare-specs table (height excludes roof side rails, width excludes mirrors); Chrome Data for ground clearance and ground-to-top-of-load-floor.

name: XRT AWD
src: hyundaiusa.com 2026 Santa Cruz compare-specs table (XRT is 0.2 in longer for its front fascia); Chrome Data for ground clearance and load-floor height.

name: Dual Motor Large Pack
src: Chrome Data 2026 Rivian R1T Dual Motor Large Pack; bed length from Rivian's own documentation (54.0 in with the tailgate up, 83.6 down). Air suspension: the height and clearance shown are the standard road ride height; Rivian publishes a maximum clearance of 14.9 in. Width excludes mirrors.

name: Dual Motor All-Wheel Drive
src: Tesla Cybertruck Owner's Manual, Dimensions, Weights and Cargo Capacity. Width excludes mirrors (86.6 in folded). Dual Motor AWD uses coil springs, so there is no ride-height variability. The bed is sloped: inner wall is 28.7 in at the front and 19.8 in at the rear; the rear figure is recorded.

name: Premium All-Wheel Drive
src: Tesla Cybertruck Owner's Manual. Air suspension: values are the Medium (standard) setting. Full published ladder runs from Entry/Exit 68.5 in height and 8.0 in clearance to Extract Mode 76.5 in and 16.0 in.

name: Cyberbeast
src: Tesla Cybertruck Owner's Manual; the Cyberbeast shares the Premium AWD body and air-suspension height ladder, shown here at the Medium setting. Curb weight is the all-season figure (6,898 lb on all-terrains).
